newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Port conditions update - Australia - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Australia - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

AUSTRALIA, July 10 - Newcastle - Coal miners at Coal and Allied's No.1 Hunter Valley mine are still on strike. The arbitration commission has now requested that both parties resume urgent talks to solve this dispute.

Train drivers belonging to the Transport Workers union so far have refused to breach the miners picket line but even if a train were to reach Newcastle, members of the MUA have advised that they would prevent coal mined by non-union labour from being loaded for export.
